## Recommended Next-Step Strategy

No updater should be written until the report confirms the real runtime structure. Based on the current symptom, the next fix will probably need to separate three responsibilities cleanly:

1. **Background layer**: `.collection-bg` should remain decorative only and should not become a carousel/product container.
2. **Title/tab layer**: `.collection-label` should stay outside any moving/cloned/translated track and should have a stable centering rule.
3. **Product layer**: mobile carousel should operate in its own viewport/track wrapper, with the original product source hidden only at the safest narrow selector level.

After reviewing this report, the fix should target the smallest confirmed selectors instead of broad mobile rules. Special attention should go to whether previous Step 7 clone wrappers are being inserted repeatedly and whether hiding the original row is also hiding or moving the plate background/title.

## Collection Background Container Risk Check

### Risk Summary

- JS targets `.collection-bg`; verify it is not appending carousel nodes into the decorative background layer.
- HTML/PHP evidence places `.collection-bg` near product markup; verify parent/child relationship before hiding original rows.
- CSS layout/background rules affect `.collection-bg`; broad mobile overrides may cause repeated/glitchy background rendering.

  407:

body.home,
  body.front-page,

    --dkg-home-stage-scale: min(1, calc((100vw - 48px) / 1400));
    --dkg-browser-zoom-counter: 1;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
  }

  /*

  body.home .site-header,

    width: 100vw !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    min-width: 100vw !important;

    margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
    margin-right: 0 !important;

    transform: none !important;
    transform-origin: top center !important;

    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }

  /*
    Header content gets counter-scaled, not the full-width header background.
    These selectors cover your current header structure and common wrappers.
  */
  body.home .site-header > *,
  body.front-page .site-header > *,
  body.page-template-front-page .site-header > * {
    transform: scale(var(--dkg-browser-zoom-counter)) !important;
    transform-origin: top center !important;
  }

  /*
    If the header has nav/logo elements without a wrapper, keep their layout
    from stretching strangely.
  */
  body.home .site-header .site-logo,

  body.front-page .site-header .site-logo,

  body.page-template-front-page .site-header .nav a,
  body.page-template-front-page .site-header .nav-social {
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }

  /*
    COLLECTION STAGE:
    This is the fixed plate area. It scales down only if viewport width
    physically cannot fit it, and also counter-scales against browser zoom.
  */
  body.home .collections-section,
  body.front-page .collections-section,
  body.page-template-front-page .collections-section {
    width: var(--dkg-home-stage-width) !important;

    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;

    padding-left: 0 !important;

    transform: scale(calc(var(--dkg-home-stage-scale) * var(--dkg-browser-zoom-counter))) !important;

  390:         function dkgReorderCartPayments() {
  391:           const checkoutButton = document.querySelector(
  392:             '.woocommerce-cart a.checkout-button, .woocommerce-cart .checkout-button, a.checkout-button, .checkout-button'
  393:           );
  394: 
  395:           if (!checkoutButton) {
  396:             return false;
  397:           }
  398: 
  399:           const checkoutGroup =
  400:             checkoutButton.closest('.wc-proceed-to-checkout') ||
  401:             checkoutButton.parentElement;
  402: 
  403:           if (!checkoutGroup) {
  404:             return false;
  405:           }
  406: 
  407:           const root =
  408:             checkoutGroup.closest('.cart_totals') ||
  409:             checkoutGroup.closest('.cart-collaterals') ||
  410:             checkoutGroup.closest('.woocommerce') ||
  411:             document.querySelector('.woocommerce-cart .woocommerce') ||
  412:             document.querySelector('.woocommerce') ||
  413:             document.body;
  414: 
  415:           if (!root) {
  416:             return false;
  417:           }
  418: 
  419:           let wrapper = root.querySelector(':scope > .dkg-cart-payment-order');
  420: 
  421:           if (!wrapper) {
  422:             wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  423:             wrapper.className = 'dkg-cart-payment-order';
  424: 
  425:             const firstRelevant =
  426:               dkgDirectChildUnder(root, checkoutGroup) ||
  427:               root.firstElementChild;
  428: 
  429:             if (firstRelevant) {
  430:               root.insertBefore(wrapper, firstRelevant);
  431:             } else {
  432:               root.appendChild(wrapper);
  433:             }
  434:           }
  435: 
  436:           const expressBlocks = [];
  437:           const possibleExpress = root.querySelectorAll('div, section, p');
  438: 
  439:           possibleExpress.forEach(function (el) {
  440:             if (el === wrapper || wrapper.contains(el) || el.contains(wrapper)) {
  441:               return;
  442:             }
  443: 
  444:             if (checkoutGroup.contains(el) || el.contains(checkoutGroup)) {
  445:               return;
  446:             }
  447: 
  448:             if (!dkgLooksLikeExpressPayment(el)) {
  449:               return;
  450:             }
  451: 
  452:             const block = dkgDirectChildUnder(root, el);
  453: 
  454:             if (
  455:               block &&
  456:               block !== wrapper &&
  457:               block !== checkoutGroup &&
  458:               !expressBlocks.includes(block)
  459:             ) {
  460:               expressBlocks.push(block);
  461:             }
  462:           });
  463: 
  464:           const existingOr = dkgFindOrSeparator(root);
  465:           let orBlock = existingOr ? dkgDirectChildUnder(root, existingOr) : null;
  466: 
  467:           if (!orBlock || orBlock === checkoutGroup || orBlock === wrapper) {
  468:             orBlock = wrapper.querySelector('.dkg-cart-or-separator');
  469: 
  470:             if (!orBlock) {
  471:               orBlock = document.createElement('div');
  472:               orBlock.className = 'dkg-cart-or-separator';
  473:               orBlock.textContent = 'OR';
  474:             }
  475:           }
  476: 
  477:           wrapper.appendChild(checkoutGroup);
  478:           wrapper.appendChild(orBlock);
  479: 
  480:           expressBlocks.forEach(function (block) {
  481:             wrapper.appendChild(block);
  482:           });
  483: 
  484:           checkoutGroup.classList.add('dkg-normal-checkout-first');
  485: 
  486:           return true;
  487:         }
  488: 
  489:         function dkgRunRepeatedly() {
  490:           dkgReorderCartPayments();
  491: 
  492:           setTimeout(dkgReorderCartPayments, 300);
  493:           setTimeout(dkgReorderCartPayments, 800);
  494:           setTimeout(dkgReorderCartPayments, 1600);

  498:

  501:         } else {

  504:
